title: Oil price tops $100 a barrel as Iran war rattles commodity markets
title_zh: 伊朗战争扰乱大宗商品市场，油价突破每桶 100 美元
summary: The price of oil hit its highest level since the outbreak of the war in Ukraine
summary_zh: 油价创乌克兰战争爆发以来最高水平

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks tumble as G7 nations plan emergency meeting over Iran war
title_zh: 富时 100 指数实时：七国集团国家计划就伊朗战争召开紧急会议，股市暴跌
summary: The meeting will discuss a joint release of petroleum from reserves, co-ordinated by the International Energy Agency (IEA).
summary_zh: 会议将讨论在国际能源署（IEA）的协调下联合释放石油储备的问题。

title: Nvidia-backed Nscale valued at $14.6 billion in fresh funding round
title_zh: Nvidia 支持的 Nscale 在新一轮融资中估值达 146 亿美元
summary: Nvidia-backed artificial intelligence group Nscale was valued at $14.6 billion after ‌raising $2 billion in its latest funding round, ‌the British company said on Monday.
summary_zh: 英伟达支持的人工智能集团 Nscale 周一表示，在最新一轮融资中筹集了 20 亿美元后，该公司的估值达到 146 亿美元。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures sell off as oil prices surge to over $110 a barrel
title_zh: 今日股市：随着油价飙升至每桶 110 美元以上，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货均遭抛售
summary: Markets are tumbling rapidly as surging oil prices have thrown equities into an unstable position amid global volatility.
summary_zh: 由于油价飙升导致股市在全球波动中陷入不稳定状态，市场正在迅速下跌。

title: Apple now has a MacBook for everyone, and that should worry Google and Microsoft
title_zh: 苹果现在为所有人提供了 MacBook，这应该让谷歌和微软感到担忧
summary: Apple's MacBook Neo is a threat to Microsoft's PC empire and the Google Chromebook's grip on the education market.
summary_zh: 苹果的 MacBook Neo 对微软的 PC 帝国和谷歌 Chromebook 对教育市场的控制构成了威胁。

title: The AI trade still 'has legs': Wall Street analysts weigh tech stock picks amid market sell-off
title_zh: 人工智能行业仍然“有活力”：华尔街分析师在市场抛售中权衡科技股选择
summary: Market ripples from the US-Iran conflict are sending investors toward tech's safe havens.
summary_zh: 美伊冲突引发的市场涟漪正促使投资者转向科技股的避风港。

title: Young Wall Streeters had a sad week
title_zh: 年轻的华尔街人士度过了悲伤的一周
summary: Bad look for the next generation of Wall Streeters.
summary_zh: 下一代华尔街人的形象很糟糕。

title: Amazon & Lululemon: 2 catalysts this portfolio mgr. sees for stocks
title_zh: 亚马逊和 Lululemon：该投资组合的 2 个催化剂看股票
summary: Rockland Trust VP and portfolio manager Michael Sayers sits down with Josh Lipton to explain why he's looking favorably on shares of Lululemon (LULU) — for the athleisure brand's expected announcement of a new CEO — and Amazon (AMZN) on the growth of its AWS segment.
summary_zh: Rockland Trust 副总裁兼投资组合经理 Michael Sayers 与 Josh Lipton 坐下来解释了为什么他看好 Lululemon (LULU) 的股票（该运动休闲品牌预计将宣布新任首席执行官）以及亚马逊 (AMZN) 的 AWS 业务增长。
